post.description:
Read title/duration/resolution of a YouTube video (≤ 20 s) and check it can be ingested.

422 `reason`: invalid_url, too_long, unknown_duration, live, private, members_only, needs_auth,
age_restricted, unavailable. 502/503/504 INGEST_FAILED `reason`: blocked, probe_failed, queue_unavailable, timeout.

Create a `youtube` video in status `ingesting` and queue the download (best stream ≤ 1080p).

Poll GET /videos/{id}: `ready` when the source is stored, `failed` with `error.reason` otherwise.

delete.description:
Delete the video: its active job is cancelled, an in-progress upload aborted, and every stored object (source,
media, segments, results, tiles, exports) is erased in the background. The video then returns 404.

post.description:
Create the video + multipart upload; returns presigned PUT URLs for the first parts.

PUT each 16 MiB slice (the last may be shorter) to its URL, keep the `ETag` response header,
then POST /videos/{id}/uploads/complete. Do not change the part size when resuming.
Presign more part URLs (≤ 100 per call), e.g. for the next batch or when resuming.

get.description: Parts already stored (ListParts) — resume uploads only the missing ones.

delete.description: Abort the multipart upload and mark the video deleted.

post.description: Verify every part (count, 16 MiB sizes, ETags), complete the upload, check the object size → `ready`.

Start analysing a video. Requires `Idempotency-Key` (a replay returns the same job).

The video must be `ready`, or a YouTube video still `ingesting` (the job then waits in status `ingesting`).
409 CONFLICT: the video already has an active job (`job_id` extension) or isn't ready (`reason: video_not_ready`).
Cancel a running job: no further stages are dispatched and queued tasks are revoked. 409 if already finished.
Resume a `failed` job (with `error.retryable`) from the stage that failed; finished stages are skipped.

get.description:
The 32 pitch landmarks (index, name, kind, metres) + painted lines of the FIFA 105 × 68 template — SCR-15
landmark menu (E03) and pitch diagram / line preview (E05). Static.

Tracks of the video's analysis, longest on screen first (`role` filters, repeatable). SCR-14 E06 lists the
goalkeepers and referees.

patch.description:
SCR-14 E06 "Fix assignment": set role + team of tracks. Display-only — tiles keep the detection; the
manifest's `track_overrides` carry the fix (re-fetch the manifest). 422 `reason`: unknown_track /
unknown_cluster.

get.description:
What the player needs before fetching tiles (fps, size, shots, coverage, teams, pitch status) for the
video's latest finished analysis. `tile_url_template` is signed and expires (`PV_TILE_URL_TTL_S`, 6 h): fetch
the manifest again when a tile answers 403. 409 `reason: processing` while the first analysis is running.

Presigned URL of the normalized video (25 fps) for the workspace player, valid `expires_in` s
(`PV_MEDIA_URL_TTL_S`, 6 h) — fetch again on a media error. 404 `reason: not_normalized` before S2 wrote it.

Teams of the video's analysis (one per team-model cluster) + sample crops per team: `sample_sheet.url` is
one image (S3's crop grid) and each team's `samples` are rectangles in it (≤ 8).

patch.description:
Confirm teams (SCR-14 E09): names (1–40 chars), colours (#rrggbb), optional swap of name + colour between the
two clusters. Display-only — tiles keep the cluster number, the manifest maps it — so nothing is reprocessed.
409 `reason: no_teams` before the analysis finished.

get.description:
Player boxes on team detection's sample frames (SCR-14 manual mode): show the frame
(`GET …/calibration/frame?t_ms=`) and let the user click boxes per team. Also after TEAM_SEPARATION_FAILED.

post.description:
Re-run team detection seeded with ≥ 2 picked players per team (SCR-14 E13): a new job of kind `team_rerun`
(reuses normalize / shots of the latest job; re-runs calibrate → infer → …). Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
409: an active job (`job_id`), or no analysis yet (`reason: no_analysis`).

get.description: Pitch calibration state for SCR-15: the latest analysis' status, a running job, the last manual points.

post.description:
Manual 4–8 point calibration (SCR-15 E09): starts a CPU-only `recalibrate` job (re-projection with the manual
homography → tiles under a new revision → positions → new manifest; ~1–2 min). Track it like any job (WS topic
`job:{id}`); the current manifest stays served until the new one is live. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
422 `reason`: frame_ms (points on different frames) · duplicate_landmark · collinear · not_analysed_shot.

Detect the pitch again automatically (SCR-20 "Map the pitch"): a `repitch` job reuses the latest analysis'
detections and tracks and runs only the pitch stage + stitch / tiles / positions. It fails with
HOMOGRAPHY_UNAVAILABLE when no pitch model is available here. Requires `Idempotency-Key`. 409 `no_analysis`.

get.description:
A still of the normalized video at `t_ms` (snapped to 25 fps) as a presigned JPEG URL (SCR-14 manual mode,
SCR-15). Extracted by a worker on first use (may take a few seconds), cached afterwards. 503 when the worker
is busy / down (retry), 404 `reason: no_video` before S2, 422 `reason: out_of_range` past the end.
5 Hz positions for analysts (AD §10.2) — the player uses the manifest + tiles instead. Keyset-paged.

schema.description: exclusive; default from_ms + 60 s; window ≤ 10 min
schema.title: To Ms

parameters.description: exclusive; default from_ms + 60 s; window ≤ 10 min

post.description:
Render the video's latest finished analysis as an MP4 (SCR-25). Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
Range omitted = full match. 402 PLAN_REQUIRED (`reason: export_quality`): 1080p needs Pro. 409 `no_analysis`.
422 `reason`: `range` (outside the video), `no_pitch_map` (layout `video_map` without pitch calibration).
Free plan exports carry a watermark (`watermark: true`).

get.description:
SCR-26, newest first. `status`: all · active (queued / running) · done. A done export past `expires_at`
reads `expired` (file deleted).

delete.description: Remove from the list (stops it if active); the file is deleted by the worker's purge.

post.description: Stop a queued / running export (409 `finished` otherwise).
Render a failed / cancelled export again with the same settings (409 `not_retryable` otherwise).

get.description:
Minutes used this calendar month (UTC) by analysis jobs that are running or done, the plan's limit and when
it resets. The plan comes from the access token (a change shows after the next token refresh).

Newest first + `unread_count` (bell badge G.E07). `path` is the web route to open; the text is rendered by
the web from `type` + `data` + `video_title`.
Videos / exports the active org holds here (DLG-08) and the caller's latest data export (SCR-40 D02).

post.description:
Start a GDPR export: a zip of your account data, plus — for admins and owners — the org's videos, analyses,
corrections and positions (not the video files). Emailed when ready; kept 7 days. 409 `in_progress`.

get.description: The org's team names + colours, most used first (≤ 200). Saved when teams are confirmed (SCR-14).

patch.description: Rename / recolour (admin+). 409 `name_taken`. Videos already analysed keep their names.

One playback tile (`pitchvision_schemas.Tile`). Use the manifest's `tile_url_template`; 403 when the
signature is invalid or expired.

TeamsPatch.title: TeamsPatch
TeamsPatch.description:
SCR-14 E02/E03/E04/E09. ``teams`` edits are applied by cluster first; then ``swap`` exchanges name + colour
of the two clusters. Send the final mapping with ``swap: false`` (recommended), or the pre-swap values with
``swap: true``. Clusters (= tile ``team`` values) never move, so no tile is regenerated.
